1939, June

5th
Paul Lahey - 16 - seemingly having Cleptomania. Olive Coughlin - 51 - had operation some months ago. Fears Cancer. Arno Paege - almost 5 - lutheran - weighs 28 1bs - cannot stand a- lone - Enrolled To-day
1939, June
Page 132 June June 6th Robert Sloan - 26 - sole support of widowed mother and young brothr unconscious for some days with concussion of brain ..... Receving Hosp.

7 Thanks - E'd J. Smith - 56 - had very threatening cancer right be- tween the sholders - enrolled Dec. 7th and prayed for. At once im- provement started, now entirely gone. Deo Gr.
Thomas Moran - 61 - is in Jennings.
Theresa Fitzmaurice - 56 - nerveous.
